purpose: Measure QH native-score and coil-engineering distributions after reducing the winding-surface minor radius and widening noncircular geometric variation.

construction: balanced-v2-scale noncircular reference axis with a larger second harmonic
compact winding surface with stronger size, elongation, orientation, triangularity, and helical-ripple variation
monotone circle-valued scalar coordinate with an added third-poloidal/second-field-period contour term
stratified contour levels fitted to order-16 Cartesian Fourier curves
generator.inner_surface_role: geometric_reference_only; not evaluated in native scoring

sample_design.conditions: 26 compact-flexible (nfp,nc) conditions: nc=1 with nfp=4..8; nc=2..4 with nfp=2..8
sample_design.duration_basis: Balanced-v2 measured 4.61--4.73 seconds per sample per GPU.
sample_design.expected_wall_time: 46--48 minutes plus short analysis; every scoring shard has a hard one-hour Slurm limit.

primary_outputs: total score and native status distributions
coil length, curvature, intercoil distance, axis distance, high-mode energy, and current diagnostics
condition-stratified statistics and representative coil HTML views

default_impact: none; qh-flow-screen32-adam200-64d-abi11-v1 remains the current default
